notes.title: Arcade Update, an unlockable Boss journey.
notes.content:
Finally, it is out... the arcade mode.

I'm excited to see this out, there is a lot of new things.
The Arcade update adds an unlockable boss, by successfully winning the arcade mode on normal or hard difficulty without a loss.
This update also include achievements, new portraits made by @the_esparon, and gameplay balance.


[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/910198013938812623/C1873C093925BC0505FC36FECDFB8D8A3ADB5F7B/[/img]
New sprites for all yeah !

The update also include new tracks for the Pao's stage and Yamaha's stage still made by @pentadrangle

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/910198013938904704/37EDC9DB0DF470FB43ECB7E5BFD168C91C8159CD/[/img]

There are 14 achievements, one for each character to win the arcade mode, and one to unlock the boss.

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/910198013938885081/4D404A47639AE7979DD68E98CD75939282E9682D/[/img]

Balance or gameplay notes :
- First thing you will notice is how fast the character goes when falling.
I increased a lot the limit of the falling speed because the game was too floaty. Now character will be back on ground faster.
- To even go further, I increased the power of the down button when falling. 
The animation is now a dive and this can be used to avoid aerial attacks.
- New way of loading maps, using less texture memory, 
- Fixed a couple of crashes, stability fixes
- Fixed some fullscreen resolutions issues.
- Added an option to show FPS
- Added Switch Joycon & pro controller auto-mapping
- Hide the mouse icon when not moving for 3 seconds.
- New typo for text here and there
- Fixed line glitches on many stages

notes.title: New Patch 0.8.8, balancing, knockbacks, fullscreen with resolution, online improvments and more
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

Here comes another update/patch to fix recent issue and the game wll be 25% OFF for a week.
I'm working a lot on the arcade mode and I can't show that right now as it is still a work in progress.

Here is just a part of the boss's stage, I don't want to show too much.

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/940591606267042280/8175872F193726E1061FA544DB95FFC9CA40CCDE/[/img]


But I do have a lot of other things that made the game more enjoyable available with this new update :

Update patch 8.8 notes :

- Fixed some crashes happening in the selection screen
- Disabled keyboard debuging keys (sorry about that one)
- Added resolutions to the fullscreen options, this can improve performance drastically for high resolution monitors.
- Changed the way clang/small clashes works, now the speed of the character influence who is gonna win a clang (finish his stun before the other), the more speed the better
- Added a timer online, it's set at 7 minutes.
- Made some attacks unparryable, powerfull attack and smash down are concerned
- Fixed Jin glitch on one attack
- Fixed the animation on slopes.
- Fixed the maximum number of players possible to 8, before it would just crash.
- Added more details and fixed camera on the stage MOONLIGHT TEMPLE
- All adjustement for characters attacks can be seen here https://docs.google.com/document/d/1q1ZrSRavvCO0dzqMWHxZanbL0v38wJsjTxJlEd9Bjlg/edit 
- Fixed the wrong knocback on neutral tile, and decreased knockback globally for tiles.
- Improved preventing attack cross up.
- Shield grab wont create parry anymore.
- if a grab on floor is failed, the player start a recovery slide animation and can't control the player right away.
- An attempt to grab from a shield disable the use of parry for 2 seconds. No more lucky parry.
- improved overall knockback to scale better.
- added online key F7 to decrease the frame delay by 1 and F8 to increase the frame delay by 1.
(depending of your connection stability, you can remove or add frame delay to improve the connection, if you face too much locked frame -> increase the delay, if the connectin is really good -> you can try decreasing the delay)

notes.title: Winter sale and a new patch
notes.content:
Hello !

With winter sales going on, Roof Rage is 30% off (tell your friends !)
, here comes a new patch to fix recent issues. 

Update patch 8.7
- Fixed the framerate droping to 1fps
- Fixed the crashes during match
- Changed the way to add cpu, now you add them directly inside the selection menu by pressing space or select.
- You can now make a match with only cpus, if you like watching
- Improved performance globally
- Made the wavedash way more consistent
- New Grab for Jin and Long
- Changed some attacks, a lot of hitboxes and startup time or end lag for many attacks, you can see what's been done in this doc (text from me in green):
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1q1ZrSRavvCO0dzqMWHxZanbL0v38wJsjTxJlEd9Bjlg/edit
I'm still working on this so you guys can expect another update soon. This one is mostly to fix the framerate drops and other crashes.

Best
Early Melon

notes.title: Patch 8.6 crashes & bugs fixes, loading time and performance improvement
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

Sorry for players who experienced crashes or other issues with the game.
This patch is here for you, I hope it fixes most of your problem.

As always, it is hard to know if it fixed everyone's issue simply because it works on my end.

But I checked with other players who had issues and it is good for them.

Here is a recap of what was done.

Update patch 8.6
- Improved loading time by a lot, divided launch time by 5
- Sounds are now streamed instead of cached, it means the memory usage is divided by ~3
- New soundtrack for The Jungle with its Showdown version
- Fixed the bug when after rematch, soft platforms are broken and act like walls on edges.
- Improved performance of the game
- Fixed each stage low walls blocking issue
- Lots of hitboxes balance patches
- New Needle down aerial when off stage
- Fixed couple of texture glitches
- Potentially fixed the xinput limitation to 4 controllers. Need someone to test it
- Fixed the defense roll direction after roll
- Fixed some movelist
- Fixed Hoon and Pakaw grab that used to activate even when failed
- Fixed tile knockback for straight throws
- Fixed some Punk hitboxes that went behind his body or sprites without hurtboxes
- Fixed Yamaha getting stuck after a ground tech counter
- Fixed bug with grab being canceled and opponent freezing/flying with no gravity
- Changed the camera behavior in fixed scale x2.

Best
Early Melon

notes.title: Yamaha patch, biggest update so far !
notes.content:
Hello again,

Thanks everyone for the long wait, it's been almost 2 months since the last big update. I've been busy as always and I'm really excited to show you what I've been working on.

[img]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/940583359442867237/E1CBF8DF21A7AC032F325CD6AD9FCC4F9BE4810F/[/img]

Let's talk about the plan for Roof Rage in Early Access, where I want to go before the full release, what is in this update and what will be in the next.

So we started at 8 characters when the game initially launched in EA, now we are at 12, my plan is to get to 14 for the full release. I already have one more character in progress who will be part of the arcade mode that we will discuss later in this annoucement.

That's already a lot of work because I do this on my own, but as you can see we're getting there. 

New UI
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/940583359444843820/876890DE66E8084BADD1281A074BC30F8485EB95/[/img]

The plan for the full release is to have 14 characters/14 stages, a proper tutorial/training mode that explains all the techs while playing.
And an arcade mode where you have to battle each character to reach the boss and eventually unlock it if you don't loose a match.

I will think to add 2vs2 online if enough players join us.
At least you will have more options available for the 1vs1 online game mode.

Now let's get to this update, there is a lot here ! We have a Sumo character !

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/940583359442804927/1A126429F93C4EEE7898902A1B0F4F1AC46F0C7E/[/img]

Here is the patch note :
Update patch 8.5
- New resolution full screen 16/9
- Made improvment with the camera at fixed scale
- New Dust effects for jump, wall jump, slides / dash, and smash down on ground
- New after image effect for some attacks for Punk, Nawi, Needle, Jin and Guan
- Couple of new SFX in game and in the menu
- Nawi new diag down aerial
- New system of Booster after performing a long combo, a booster with make you faster as long as you keep the combo going and has a blue after image effect
- New bouncing system for walls, the bounce impulse is now working as it should and create more possibilities of combos.
- Fixed a bug with the camera when waiting for a player online.
- Fixed a bug where you could tech in the air.
- Fixed the bug with soft plateform edges interfering with attacks or movements
- grab wont work vs attack, only vs shield and a non attacking opponent (I will make it that it can grab during a startup animation though)
- ground grab won't grab a character in air
- Globally fixed the knockback from a straight hit, it used to go Up too much now it's a more linear knockback
- Fixed broken combinations during a multi hits attack, for example Hoon Fair kicks
- New menu UI during the selection screen plus the move list
- New Sumo character Yamaha, expert clapping fighter, watch out for his towel clap
- New performance improvment, and fixed a couple reason of desync again.
- Needle faster recovery Uair startup, and faster normal uAir
- Pakaw longer knee kick, and few buffs
- Hoon faster fireball aerial startup, and better animation
- Improved colors in the menu
- Punk new special up on ground
- Improved the camera movement to have more stage influence, it means it will follow players a bit less to be able to see the stage when a player is high up.
- Nawi fixed some hitboxes to actually hit a small character with ground normals, and fixed some of her impulse for some attack.
- Fixed a Thyra hitbox bug on her Ftilt
- Added the missing dash down
- Fixed Leon dash which was too small
- Gave every dash a bit of extra length
- Fixed the perma link to Discord, added it to the steam page too.
- Fixed the soft platform bug where a smash down would activate and still go through
- Reduced all the diag down knockback by a lot, it makes recovery from it an option and avoid a lot of early kill.
- Removed the shield bubble and replaced it by a defensive stance, you can block as many attacks as you want but defensive stance only works when a player attacks on your defensive side. Defensive stance are grabbable
- A defensive stance won't block some heavy attacks, the one that used to break the shield.


As you can see, I didn't procrastinate... In fact, I will need a lot of feedback on this because some game mechanics changed drastically.


[img]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/940583359442852461/123D5E9901AD85E79D4AF36F8F1C0E563E4437F8/[/img]

notes.title: Nisassa Update, a new Ninja character, a new stage and a new online system.
notes.content:
In today big announcement, we have a new character and a new stage plus tons of new things and fixes.

First let me introduce Nisassa : 
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/948459872557189786/D34C98C4F750698B64C2E0F9BA5D617F67719FCA/[/img]

Nisassa is a highly skilled assassin-for-hire, as well as the younger sister of Jin, she charges a hefty price for her service. She tends to rely on stealth and counter-attacks more than directly engaging an opponent.

[img]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/948459872557253442/3159FA32F6DAC18ACDBA5D77C803217768ABA992/[/img]
And yes she has a bow and can teleport to her thrown arrow, the arrow carries the opponent for a bit when it hits. If her arrow takes a hit, Nisassa automatically teleports there and take the hit.							


We also introduce a new system for online matchmaking, now you can create a lobby and continue to play the game locally while waiting.
You can view and join lobbies in the menu, you can join them randomly and we still have Steam invitation.

We also have a new stage : 
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/948459872557269865/AB40F2AD1AEA15D6B4D79C3B58E9AB815AD5C357/[/img]
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/948459872557310180/F1419895999237270D31B591BB03F11D45C939A5/[/img]

And a new soundtrack for "The Ring" that just made it into the update ːsteamhappyː

This patch includes those changes :

Patch note version 0.8.3
- New character  Nisassa Jin's sister
- New Stage : Last Battle
- New soundtrack for the ring
- New system online, create a lobby (while keep playing) / join a lobby
- Selection screen menu color palette changed
- LeaderBoard now have a universal font to include Asian characters
- New system for the shield (it's gonna be gone soon replaced by a defensive stance), right now the only difference is that you can buffer it. it deactivate and roll after 200ms if you have the side direction pushed.
- Leon new dtilt, ftilt
- New system for projectiles to follow the character's movement better.
- Ambiance sounds are back
- Clashes deal more knockbacks plus a new system to avoid mutli collisions hitboxes
 
Balancing update : 

- Guan laser nerf, longer startup
- Thyra, Guan ftilt longer end lag
- reworked hitboxes on Guan, Punk, Pakaw, Leon, Long, Hoon, Jin, Thyra
- Pakaw tornado damage nerf
- changed speed and acceleration of Needle, Leon, Nawi, Guan, Jin

notes.title: Pakaw Update
notes.content:
Here comes a new challenger !

This is the second big update to the game, we introduce Pakaw, our Muay Thai boxer.
With this update, the game will be 50% OFF FOR A WEEK ! 
Starting 10th August 10am pacific time.

[img]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/955213082859474632/F99644A5920D41D5AA7AD893BC0458326A93B159/[/img]

He has a unique play style, heavy on the ground, fighting with a combination of hard punches and knee strikes. 
His stage is a ring with bouncing ropes on both side, a new way to create combos.

[img]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/955213082859443139/152458E40DA22767C46A040B62DBCA76E5695AFB/[/img]

The game now has 10 characters and 10 stages.

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/955213082859494979/577586E2C7AC4AC973542ED5AB18BE38EA0B5F53/[/img]

This update also include a beta ranked match & leaderboard. It means that any match online will be ranked for now, it is based on an ELO system, the higher in rank your opponent is the more score you get.
Every one starts at 1000 points.

You can see the leaderboard in the game or here : 
https://steamcommunity.com/stats/724300/leaderboards/2874238/

What changed in the recent updates : 

- New input for grab, shield + normal attack
- Rolling now change side by default, it means if you shield and roll + release the direction input, the characater would face his opposite side (if you avoid an opponent attack, you will most likely be facing him at this moment) if the shield is still pressed then you only need to input a normal attack to make a grab possible here.
- Some change in the menu to be able to have more options, see more controllers
- Fixed some online freezes that disconnected players.
- Needle new slide attack, with a up momentum making it easier to connect to the next move.
- Fixed grabs
- Changed some hitboxes/hurtboxes on few characters attacks.

We hope that this update and the week sale will bring more players to the game, please tell your friends about it and let's make this great together !

notes.title: Nawi Update, new character, new stage and online desync fixes. v.0.8.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone

Here comes a new challenger !

[img]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/924811883709393579/AA2D8CAFF8F2FAD115AFF4DAED993C7DE9BA186D/[/img]

I present you Nawi, the new character and her stage.
She has long legs, using capoeira techniques and has 2 grabs, one's midair.

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/924811883709412701/6CC4EF464964D31DF8B8912143EAF2A6132B644A/[/img]

We worked on this update for the last 2 weeks, we were able to fix a lot of issues online (desync) and also a lot of frame locked online.

I hope you guys can enjoy some game online now without facing too much issues or lag and start creating more tournaments.

Thanks to this, replays are also working better and are less likely to stop.

Other things in this update :
- Now players can't push each others anymore (part of the online fix)
- Each character's normal attacks  have a faster startup, it makes the game feels more responsive.
- Grabs on ground are now performed with a double tap forward (yes only direction), to avoid confusion with other attacks like forward normal or forward smash attack.
- New attack on ground up special for Leon (wip)
- And many other bug fixes.

notes.title: Update build 0.7.4
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm sorry this is the first time I announce an update here but I have been updating the game a few times already since the release to fix critical issues.
Some of the bugs are still not fixed, like crashing during the startup, and I'm still looking at how to fix those issues.

In this update though, I've made navigation with keyboard a lot more simple, because so many of you complained about that.

Before you could remap your keyboard keys and mess up the navigation in the menu with it and on top of that the default keys were not ideal at all.

So now, the keyboard navigation in the menu is static : 
- up, down to navigate
- left, right, to change settings
- Enter to confirm or to add a keyboard player in the selection menu
- Escape to go back or unselect your character
- F1 to toggle fullscreen
- Tab to switch team
- no more use of the Space Bar because it was conflicting.

You can still remap your keyboard keys for the combat.
I added a button to reset keyboard controls to default in case people need to delete their keys preferences.

Another thing to fix issues some players had : 
Now when you enter the selection screen there is no player activated at all, I removed the auto added players because it was creating issues for some of you.
Now you need to press Start or Enter to add a controller or a keyboard player.
CPUs are still there automatically.

I also fixed a crash and a black screen after the map selection.
I'm still fixing crashes, I will come back with another patch really soon, thanks for your understanding.
